description: This file defines functions related to checking the presence of configured credentials for bundled web search providers within an OpenClaw plugin context. It includes a utility for verifying credential values and a main function that determines if any such provider is properly configured based on the provided configuration, environment variables, and search settings.

methods.name: function hasConfiguredCredentialValue(value: unknown): boolean { hasConfiguredCredentialValue
methods.description: Checks if a given value is a valid, non-empty credential string or non-null/undefined value.

methods.name: export function hasBundledWebSearchCredential(params: { hasBundledWebSearchCredential
methods.description: Main exported function that determines if any bundled web search provider has a valid credential configured, based on given configuration, environment, and search configuration.
